title: Challenges
sub: Short games to try at your own pace. They're for your own tracking, not a measure of your health.

video.name: Focus for a Moment
video.desc: A short oasis scene, then questions about what you saw.
video.purpose: A short attention exercise for a spare moment.
video.instructions: You'll watch a 24-second oasis scene. Watch the details, then I'll ask you about it.

mem.name: What Do You Remember?
mem.desc: Memorize the shapes and colors, then tell me what vanished.
mem.purpose: Visual memory rounds that gradually get harder.
mem.instructions: Memorize the shapes and their colors, then tell me what vanished.

seq.name: Put It in Order
seq.desc: Order the steps of a real day by dragging or tapping.
seq.purpose: Practice ordering steps before you start them.
seq.instructions: Put the steps in the order that makes sense to you. Drag or tap them.

time.name: Where Did the Time Go?
time.desc: Guess the duration, then compare it with the actual time.
time.purpose: See the gap between how time feels and how long it took.
time.instructions: Estimate how many seconds a simple task will take, then we'll compare.

calm.name: Take It Easy
calm.desc: Calm breathing at your pace, or a break without breathing.
calm.purpose: A quiet pause in your day, and you can skip it.
calm.instructions: Breathe with me at your own pace, or take a break without breathing. Your call.

start2.name: Just Two Minutes
start2.desc: Pick a task you keep putting off and start its smallest step.
start2.purpose: Helps you begin a delayed task with one small step.
start2.instructions: We'll pick a delayed task and start it with one small step.

attention_scene.name: What Changed?
attention_scene.desc: Compare two scenes and spot the differences.
attention_scene.purpose: Attention to detail, with no rush.
attention_scene.instructions: Here are two scenes. In the second one, tap what changed.

priority_board.name: What Comes First?
priority_board.desc: Sort your tasks into now, later and not today.
priority_board.purpose: Lightens the load when everything feels important.
priority_board.instructions: Sort the tasks into three lists, then pick what comes first. There's no wrong answer.

breakdown.name: Break It Down
breakdown.desc: Split a big task into small steps and make a plan.
breakdown.purpose: Turns a big task into a clear first step.
breakdown.instructions: Write down a big task, split it into small steps, and make a simple plan.

study_sprint.name: Study Sprint
study_sprint.desc: A short study session with a place to park distractions.
study_sprint.purpose: A short focus session for study or work.
study_sprint.instructions: Pick a length that suits you and start. Note down anything distracting, then come back.

emotion_map.name: How Are You Feeling?
emotion_map.desc: Choose how you feel and what might help, in your own terms.
emotion_map.purpose: An optional pause to note how you feel, in your own terms.
emotion_map.instructions: Choose how you feel right now, if you want to. I don't guess your feelings. This is your answer.

calm_landscape.name: Take a Break
calm_landscape.desc: A calm oasis to interact with at your own pace.
calm_landscape.purpose: A short visual break between tasks.
calm_landscape.instructions: A calm oasis. Tap the lanterns, water and palm, or just look.

micro_start.name: Just the First Step
micro_start.desc: Shrink the first step of a task until it feels easy, then try it.
micro_start.purpose: Makes starting smaller when a task feels too big to begin.
micro_start.instructions: Pick a task, make its first step smaller until it feels doable, then try it with a short timer or none.

thought_sort.name: Let's Think It Through
thought_sort.desc: Sort what's on your mind into what you can act on, what's uncertain and what can wait.
thought_sort.purpose: Helps you see which worries have a next step and which you can set down for now.
thought_sort.instructions: Write down what's on your mind, sort each one, then choose one small next step if you like. It stays on your device.

groupLabel: What do you want to do now?
